newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Ford to hold news conference amid speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Ford to hold news conference amid speculation.

text.p: Sen. Wendell Ford, the second-ranking Democrat in the Senate, will hold a news conference at the Kentucky state capitol Monday amid speculation he will not seek re-election when his current term expires next year.
Ford's staff would not disclose what the senator would announce at the news conference, scheduled for 2 p.m. EST.
A Democratic official said he thought Ford would announce that he would not run when his current term expires next year.

Ford, 73, is assistant Democratic leader. He was first elected to the Senate in 1974 and has been a protector of his state's important tobacco industry. He was the chief Democratic sponsor of a law making it easier to register to vote.
